title: STRATA Memory Schema
description: Schema for the STRATA semantic memory spine in Creative Liberation Engine V6. This defines the structure of knowledge artifacts before they are embedded into the vector database.

id.description: Unique identifier for the knowledge fragment (UUID or hash).

source.description: The origin of this memory fragment.

platform.description: If harvested, the platform it originated from (e.g., Udemy, Threads, X).

content.description: The raw text content or markdown to be embedded.

metadata.description: Additional tags and structural information for hybrid search.
